d.ko: Grapples Galore is a fast-paced online multiplayer arena shooter with physics-based grappling hook movement, active ragdolls, and thrilling gunplay.
d.en: Grapples Galore is a fast-paced online multiplayer arena shooter with physics-based grappling hook movement, active ragdolls, and thrilling gunplay.
d.zh: Grapples Galore 是一款快节奏的在线多人竞技场射击游戏，拥有基于物理的抓钩移动、动态布娃娃效果和刺激的枪战玩法。
